question: What part of currently authorized MAP-001 can be represented with TILE-GRAMMAR-CANDIDATE-v0.2 without inference, what must remain OPEN, and what reveals a REPRESENTATIONAL_GAP?
sourceToTargetDirection: mapping assessment kept separate from validator result

requiredChecks: MAP-001 Candidate 002 SHA-256 matches the frozen baseline
Tile Grammar Candidate v0.2 SHA-256 matches the frozen baseline
Tile Grammar validator v0.2 SHA-256 matches the frozen baseline
baselinePreflight.rule: If any preflight check fails, stop before executing PI-01..PI-07. INVALID_BASELINE is not REVISE or INSUFFICIENT.

prohibited: using validatePatch() 3x3 as the MAP-001 integration gate
promoting the provisional raster to authoritative walkableEnvelope
deriving route.kind=path or route.ports from walkableCells alone
auto-deriving blocker edge signatures from sideContainment
inferring metric scale or geographic cardinality
encoding bridge/gate/house as terrain semantics unless a separate authorized overlay contract exists
treating test scaffolding as MAP-001 evidence or authority
treating validator PASS as equivalent to mapping REPRESENTABLE without provenance assessment

executableFixturePolicy.scaffoldRule: Any value required only to satisfy validateTile() and not authorized by MAP-001 must be marked TEST_SCAFFOLD.
executableFixturePolicy.evaluatedAdjacenciesOnly: Only the 16 shared orthogonal adjacencies derived from the 17 provisional walkable cells are evaluated as MAP-001 mappings.
executableFixturePolicy.nonEvaluatedEdges: Fields required by validateTile() on non-evaluated edges may use TEST_SCAFFOLD and must be marked NOT_EVALUATED_AS_MAP_MAPPING.

mappingTargets.target: compatible shared traversal on corresponding local edges
mappingTargets.limitation: proves local edge compatibility only; does not authorize route.kind=path, route.ports, pathfinding, global navigability, exact walkableEnvelope geometry, width, or metric distance
MAP-001 raster has no authoritative pathCells/per-cell route overlay mapping
tile grammar v0.2 does not encode progressionRole=entry|exit
integer 0 may be used only as a relative encoding; elevation.mode may remain TEST_SCAFFOLD and 0 never means meters

mappingTargets.target: specific blocker edges / hard blocker cells

requiredFixtures.purpose: verify runtime and all pinned baseline inputs before any mapping execution
derive 17 provisional walkable cells, confirm 16 orthogonal shared adjacencies, one connected component, zero branching nodes, and validate local shared traversal without deriving a path overlay
normalize MAP-001 path reference-band to a relative code without metric claim and without treating elevation.mode scaffolding as source-derived evidence
verify adapter output contains zero inferred water/bank edge signatures derived from stream.polylineCells
verify adapter output contains zero inferred blocker/cliff/hard-blocker edge signatures derived from sideContainment
record screen_up exit and screen_down entry outside Tile Grammar without claiming progressionRole is represented by the terrain grammar
verify bridge/gate/house, interactionLearning and camera remain outside terrain grammar mapping
verify TEST_SCAFFOLD is never relabeled as SOURCE_EXPLICIT, DERIVED_FROM_TEST_RASTER or NORMALIZED_ENCODING and never supports a territorial conclusion

resultSemantics.validatorResult: Technical result returned by validateTile()/validateEdgeMatch() for the executable fixture.
resultSemantics.mappingAssessment: Independent assessment of whether the tested target is justified by authorized MAP-001 input and provenance.
resultSemantics.rule: validatorResult=PASS must never imply mappingAssessment=REPRESENTABLE by itself.

decisionRules.INVALID_BASELINE: any PI-00 preflight check fails; stop test and do not classify as REVISE or INSUFFICIENT
decisionRules.PASS: all authorized SOURCE_EXPLICIT / DERIVED / NORMALIZED mappings behave as declared; all OPEN/OUT_OF_SCOPE boundaries remain preserved; no prohibited inference occurs; provenance integrity passes; no material representational gap is found within tile-grammar scope
decisionRules.REVISE: a false positive, false negative, unjustified normalization, provenance leak, or correctable under-specification appears without requiring replacement of the candidate model
decisionRules.INSUFFICIENT: a material MAP-001 requirement that belongs inside terrain grammar cannot be represented without extending or replacing the current grammar
decisionRules.precedence: INVALID_BASELINE stops execution; otherwise INSUFFICIENT > REVISE > PASS
